subject.title: perf(agents): wave-1 tool output contracts for code mode

question: Is the supplied test-and-benchmark evidence sufficient to accept these new permanent Code Mode prompt contracts, or should the PR first include a redacted real Code Mode execution showing the declared hints are used correctly?
rationale: The permanent behavioral effect is prompt/catalog content rather than a conventional API response, and the supplied PR body reports validation without an inspectable after-fix runtime artifact.

options.title: Require runtime proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript or recording that shows the affected tool hints in a real Code Mode run and confirms the intended no-inspection path.

options.title: Accept test evidence
options.body: Treat the focused schema/value tests and benchmark claims as adequate evidence for this internal prompt-surface change.

recommendation.title: Require runtime proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript or recording that shows the affected tool hints in a real Code Mode run and confirms the intended no-inspection path.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the supplied tool-contract series and is the available routing candidate for the requested proof context.
